setup.name: daf-setup
setup.description: Project setup after `daf global-setup`: greenfield copies ~/.config/agent/scaffold into .agent/ (optional /grill-me later); brownfield runs inventory + interview then merge scaffold and populate PRD/glossary/architecture; verify-state.json; optional Cursor overlay. Use when the user says /setup or needs .agent/ in the project.

grill-me.name: daf-grill-me
grill-me.description: Runs a structured planning interview into PRD sections (goal, non-goals, v1 scope, success) and recommends a stack id. Use when the user says grill-me, /grill-me, or is in planning and needs product clarity before implementation.

new-project.name: daf-new-project
new-project.description: Deprecated alias for /setup — greenfield DAF bootstrap. Use /setup instead when the user says /new-project or first-time project setup.

migrate.name: daf-migrate
migrate.description: Deprecated alias for /setup — brownfield merge and adoption. Use /setup plus planning alignment when the user says /daf-migrate or adopts DAF on an existing codebase.

new-feature.name: daf-new-feature
new-feature.description: Implements net-new product capability in **developing** phase (new commands, skills, flows) with acceptance checks; verification follows /task (taskCheck, verify-state, periodic codebase-check). Not for polish on existing behavior — use /improvement. In **maintaining**, use only when the user explicitly opts in. Use when the user says /new-feature or asks for scoped new capability while phase is developing.

issue.name: daf-issue
issue.description: Triages and fixes a reported issue in **developing** or **maintaining**: reproduce, narrow cause, minimal fix; verification follows /task. Use when the user says /issue or reports a bug to fix.

improvement.name: daf-improvement
improvement.description: Improves existing code, docs, or workflow (refactor, clarity, performance, ergonomics) — not bugs (/issue) and not net-new product capability (/new-feature). Verification follows /task like new-feature. Use when the user says /improvement or asks to make something existing better.

pivot.name: daf-pivot
pivot.description: Guides restructuring or redesign of an existing feature, concept, or architecture: from→to, blast radius, update GLOSSARY/ARCHITECTURE/PRD, migration plan, then implement via /task in developing or maintaining. Not incremental polish (/improvement), net-new capability (/new-feature), brownfield DAF adoption (/daf-migrate), or open exploration (/discuss). Use when the user says /pivot or decides to redesign something that already exists.

task.name: daf-task
task.description: Canonical workflow in **developing** or **maintaining**: session goals in chat only, per-goal config.taskCheck, monotonic taskCount in verify-state.json, modulo codebaseEvery triggers two-phase codebase-check (snapshot then config.check). In **maintaining**, also branch guard before edits and **config.check every session** — see phases/maintaining.md and /task. Use when the user says /task or when implementing under /new-feature, /issue, /improvement, or /pivot.

discuss.name: daf-discuss
discuss.description: Explores a topic, idea, or direction through dialogue — brainstorm and tradeoffs without implementing. Not bugs (/issue), ranked build plans (/improvement), PRD interviews (/grill-me), or net-new builds (/new-feature). Use when the user says /discuss or wants to think through something before committing.

remember.name: daf-remember
remember.description: Saves a user-stated standing instruction to .agent/memory/remember.md for this project. Not retro takeaways (/retro) or discovered gotchas. Use when the user says /remember or asks the agent to always follow a project rule.

retro.name: daf-retro
retro.description: Captures short retro notes for memory/learnings or gotchas after non-trivial work. Use when the user says /retro or asks for a brief retrospective.

phase-transition.name: daf-phase-transition
phase-transition.description: Validates planning exit checklist before editing config.phase to developing or maintaining (same rules as validatePlanningExit in the DAF repo). Use when the user says /phase-transition or asks to leave planning.
